description: This file manages WhatsApp session handling, including socket creation, credential storage, connection management, and QR code handling for login flows.

methods.name: enqueueSaveCreds
methods.description: Queues credential save operations per auth directory to prevent concurrent writes.

methods.name: safeSaveCreds
methods.description: Performs safe saving of credentials with backup and error handling.

methods.name: createWaSocket
methods.description: Creates and initializes a WhatsApp Web socket connection with credential management and QR code support.

methods.name: waitForWaConnection
methods.description: Waits for the WebSocket connection to be fully established.

methods.name: waitForCredsSaveQueue
methods.description: Waits for all pending credential save operations to complete.

methods.name: waitForCredsSaveQueueWithTimeout
methods.description: Waits for credential save operations with a timeout to prevent indefinite blocking.

methods.name: newConnectionId
methods.description: Generates a new UUID for connection identification.
